content: Godaape Yida Tama

Isra7eele asay bantana gakida metuwan Godaa bolla zuuzumidosona. Enta zuuzuntha Goday si7ida wode iya hanqoy eexin, xuuggiya tama enta bolla yeddis; he tamay enti dunkaanida gutaape issi bagga gaxaa mis.
Yaatin Musey enta gisho Godaa woossana mela enti Museko yidi yeekidosona. Musey woossin tamay to7is.
Godaa tamay enta giddon eexida gisho, he bessay Tabeera
geetetidi xeegetis.
Isra7eeletara Gibxefe keyida dumma dumma derey hara kathi maanaw daro amotidosona. Enti, “Nu asho awupe demmanee?
Nuuni Gibxen de7iya wode miishe qanxonna miya moluwa, leehiya, habaabe, shunkurte, miskati bayna shunkurtenne tuumuwa hassayoos.
Shin ha77i nu qoodhey gordetis; nu ayfeyka ha mannafe attishin, haraba aybaka be7enna” yaagidi yeekidosona.
Mannay deebbo ayfe daanees; iya malay bootha adil7e ciishshe daanees.
Mannay qamma wodhees; asay yuuyidi iya maxidi woxan gaaccidi woyko udulan caddidi kathoosona. Yaatidi uukosona; iya mal7oy shamaho zaytera uuketida uytha mela.
Manni qamma enta gutan akara wodhees.
Asay banta dunkaaniya pengen pengen eqidi yeekishin Musey si7is. Enti Godaa hanquwa denthethida gisho, Musey un7etis.
Musey Godaako, “Ne aylliya, ta bolla ayis ha metuwa ehadii? Ne tanan ayis ufaytabikii? Ne ha asa ubbaa toohuwa ta bolla ayis wothadii?
Ha asa ubbaa ta qanthatadinayee? Woyko enta ta yeladinaayee? Ne enta mayzatas, immana gada caaqida biitta gatho gada na7a idimmada dichiya aseeda ta ki7on ayis enta yeggadii?
Ha asa ubbaas ta asho awupe ehanee? Enti taako yidi, ‘Maanaw nuus asho imma’ yaagidi yeekosona.
Taani ha asa ubbaa tarka tookanaw danda7ike; taw hessi deexo tooho.
Hiza neeni tana haysada oothanaape taw qadheta; ha77i tana wodha; ha metuwape ta shempa aggana” yaagis.
Laapun Tammu Asaa Dooretetha
Goday Museko, “Asaa kaalethanaw danda7iya Isra7eele halaqatape laapun tammu cimata doora. Enta Geeshsha Dunkaaniyako ehada ne matan essa.
Taani wodhada neera yan odetana; ta new immida Ayyaanape shaakada enta bolla wothana. Neeni asaa toohuwa nerka tookonna mela enti nena maaddana.

“Neeni asaako haysada yaaga; ‘Wonto hinte asho maana gisho hintena geeshshite. Nu asho awupe demmanee? Nuus Gibxen sa7i lo77oshin’ yaagidi hinte yeekida yeehuwa Goday si7is. Ha77i Goday asho immana; hinteka maana.
Hinte maanay issi gallas woyko nam7u gallas woyko ichashu gallas woyko tammu gallas woyko laatamu gallas xalaala gidenna.

Shin ‘Hinte giddon de7iya Godaa hinte kadhida gishonne Gibxefe keyonna attidaako nuus lo77oshin gida gisho, hintew siidhera keyana gakanawunne hinte saletana gakanaw issi ageena kumethi hinte asho maana’ yaaga” yaagis.
Shin Musey Godaako, “Heko, ta 600,000 asaa kaalethashe de7ayis. Neeni issi ageena kumethi enti asho maana mela immana gaasa.
Miiza wudenne dorsa wude ubbaa shukin entaw gidanee? Abban de7iya molo ubbaa shiishiyako entaw gidanee?” yaagis.
Yaatin, Goday Museko, “Godaa kushey qantheyee? Taani new odiyabay tumeekonne wordoko neeni ha77i be7ana” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, Musey kare keyidi, Goday gidaysa asaas odis. Isra7eele cimatape laapun tammu asaa shiishidi, Geeshsha Dunkaaniya yuushon essis.

Yaatin, Goday shaarara wodhidi iyara odetis; iya bolla de7iya Ayyaanape ekidi, he laapun tammu cimata bolla wothis. Ayyaanay enta bolla shempida wode enti nabeda tinbite odidosona. Shin hessafe guye, zaaridi tinbite odibookona.

He laapun tammu cimatara xaafetida asatape Eldaadanne Modaada geetetiya nam7ati dunkaanida gutan attidi Geeshsha Dunkaaniyako yibookona. Shin enta bollaka Ayyaanay wodhin, dunkaanida gutan tinbite odidosona.
Issi pantha addey Museko woxi yidi, “Eldaadinne Modaadi dunkaanida gutan tinbite odoosona” yaagis.
Yaanin, ba na7atethafe doomidi, Muse maaddiya Nawe na7aa Iyyasuy Museko, “Ta godaw, Muse, enta teqa” yaagis.
Shin Musey zaaridi, “Ta gisho ne qanaatay? Goday ba asa ubbaa bolla ba ayyaana wothidi nabeda tinbite odisiyaba gidiyako ta ufaytayis” yaagis.
Yaatidi, Museynne Isra7eele cimati dunkaanida gutaa simmidosona.
Qoponna Goday carko denthidi, sa7ape nam7u wadha mela dhoqu gidi piradhiya kuraachota abbafe ehis. Enta dunkaaniya yuushuwan ubba baggara issi gallasa oge mela sa7an wodhidosona.

He gallasinne he qamma ubbaa, qassi wontetha gallasika asay kare keyidi, he kuraachota oykidi shiishidosona. Entafe oonika 10 kilo giraamepe guuthu shiishibenna. Enti dunkaaniya guta yuushon melisanaw miccidosona.
Shin ashoy buroo enta doonan de7ishininne meetetidi wuronna de7ishin, Godaa hanqoy asaa bolla eexis; Goday asaa wolqaama boshan shocis.
Asho amotidi hayqida asaa enti he bessan moogida gisho he bessay Kebroot-Hataaba
geetetidi sunthetis.
Asay he bessaafe dendi bidi Haxeroota geetetiya bessan dunkaanidosona.

footnotes.text: Kebroot-Hataaba: Ha sunthaa birshethay “Amo duufo” guussu.
